title: Tyler, the Creator: From Odd Future Rebel to Grammy Winner
imageHint: The genre-bending artist with his signature colorful aesthetic and bold creative vision
description: Tyler Okonma's evolution from controversial Odd Future ringleader to introspective, Grammy-winning artist represents one of hip-hop's most fascinating creative transformations.

questions.question: What is the name of the hip-hop collective that Tyler, the Creator founded and led?
acceptableAnswers: Odd Future Wolf Gang Kill Them All
questions.explanation: Tyler founded Odd Future Wolf Gang Kill Them All (OFWGKTA) in 2007, launching the careers of Frank Ocean, Earl Sweatshirt, and others from this Los Angeles collective.

questions.question: For which 2019 album did Tyler, the Creator win his first Grammy Award for Best Rap Album?
questions.explanation: Tyler won the 2020 Grammy Award for Best Rap Album for "IGOR" (2019), his fifth studio album that showcased his evolution toward more melodic, introspective music.

questions.question: What annual music festival does Tyler, the Creator curate and host in Los Angeles?
questions.explanation: Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival, started in 2012, is Tyler's annual festival featuring diverse lineups that reflect his eclectic musical tastes, from hip-hop to indie rock.

questions.question: Tyler created an alter ego character for his 2011 album "Goblin." What is this character's name?
questions.explanation: Dr. TC (Dr. Tyler Creator) appears as Tyler's therapist throughout "Goblin," creating narrative conversations that explore Tyler's psychological state and artistic persona.

questions.question: What fashion brand did Tyler launch in 2011, known for its pastel colors and playful designs?
questions.explanation: Golf Wang ("Wolf Gang" backwards) became Tyler's fashion empire, reflecting his evolution from dark, edgy aesthetics to bright, colorful designs that mirror his musical transformation.
